prelaunch_updates.text: Public devnet is open (official @flop_labs, quoting Arthur Hayes): test FLOP faucet, explorer, API, MCP and an SDK for calling verified inference from agents. Devnet does not count toward any airdrop. Still no FLOP token; any FLOP token is a scam.

OPEN CAMPAIGN update: Pre-Mainnet Staking announced. From GEN launch day ("THE DAY", still undated) unclaimed airdrop GEN counts as staked and earns 1 Staking Point per GEN per day; the leaderboard decides validator node seats for mainnet. Season 2 points continue. Only link: airdrop.genlayer.com.

OPEN CAMPAIGN: Road to TGE is live (official). Verified on-chain trading (long, short or agent) earns weekly points; needs real trades. A Sun 11/8 snapshot appears only in participant posts (unconfirmed). Not on the watchlist; any AMA token is unconfirmed.
Milestone (already trading): QTC swaps are live inside the Quantus wallet from 180+ assets on 35+ chains, powered by NEAR Intents.
OPEN CAMPAIGN closed: Quest and Mindshare ended Mon 11/2 7:00 AM CST (13:00 UTC) with the final points distribution. Account creation fee waiver runs through Sun 11/8. Any QUIP token is a scam.
Launched an Agents Helping Agents bounty board: an agent that cannot finish a task posts a bounty and other agents earn a reward after verification. No TGE date yet.

Amadeus says the road to TGE has started and its Magnum Opus draw added 20 winners (140 total). It cites 4M+ agents and $93M+ agentic volume. No TGE date, tokenomics or token address yet; any AMA token now is a scam.

Unofficial fan account @FlopNetwork relays a Flop Labs team FAQ (said to be updated 10/30): Hayes CEO, CTO Sergey Vidyuk, CSO Shu Duan, funded only by Maelstrom, no pre-mine, Labs will not run validators. Not verified from Flop Labs directly. No FLOP token exists.

Milestone (already trading): Neoxa exchange listed SOQ with a USDC pair, and the Scrypt Wallet integration is live (both posted by @soqucoin). Small venues; still no official DEX route. Score 65 held.

OPEN CAMPAIGN repeat: Quest and Mindshare campaigns end Mon 11/2 at 7:00 AM CST (13:00 UTC) with the final points distribution (official). @quipnetwork posted nothing new overnight; the wave of "final stretch to mainnet" posts comes from campaign participants. No QUIP token yet; any QUIP token is a scam.

notes.text: GenLayer (71) is the pre-launch project closest to the bar. It is still missing a dated GEN launch day, an audit and an official token address, so no priority.
Flop (55) now has a public devnet, which helps its tech score once tested, but the team, tokenomics and testnet dates are still unannounced.
Quip (65) needs its external audit and a dated TGE. Its quest campaigns ended Mon 11/2.
Ritual (76) is already alerted and live. It rose 58% to $0.030 (range $0.017 to $0.037) on about $1.4M volume with no official news; still no real DEX pool or audit. Treat the move as unexplained.

Quantus (81) $67.82 (-1%), already trading so no launch alert; its wallet now swaps into QTC via NEAR Intents. Neptune Cash (-5% on about $2.4k) and Gonka (about $1k) are thin books, not used for scores.
Soqucoin trades on SafeTrade, NonKYC and Neoxa only (no DEX). TensorCash trades only on SafeTrade.
Tier comes from the Oracle Score (75+ Strong, 55 to 74 Watch, under 55 Speculative). It does not reflect market cap, and "No DEX" only means there is no official DEX route.
Pearl (PRL) has no official DEX route. The Uniswap WPRL token comes from a third-party bridge and the Solana "PEARL" pools are fakes.
QRL and Abelian have no DEX because QRL and ABEL tokens on Base or Solana are look-alike; Abelian also trades on only one exchange (MEXC).
